description: This file defines a class that adds a specific transformation for 'a' tags to include the 'rel="noopener noreferrer"' attribute to improve security when links open in new tabs. It is part of the HTMLPurifier library extending its HTML module functionality to prevent security vulnerabilities related to target attributes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_TargetNoopener
classes.description: A class that extends HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule to add a transformer for 'a' tags to include rel='noopener noreferrer'.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the module by adding a blank 'a' element and attaching an attribute transformation for target no-opener.
